turns.user_message: What should I know about safety and events near Ashmont this weekend?
turns.assistant_answer:
Hey there! Happy to help you get the scoop on what's happening around Ashmont this weekend.

For events, you've got a couple of things to note. On **August 1st**, the Boston Ballet is hosting an Open Studio Day in Brighton, perfect for families with little ones aged 16 months to 6 years to try a free class and meet the faculty. Then, on **August 2nd**, there's an "Open Streets Boston" event happening in Jamaica Plain from 10:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., which means streets will be closed to cars for the festivities.

Here are upcoming events I found:

- **Boston Ballet Open Studio Day** — AUGUST 1
  AUGUST 1 Brighton. Families of children ages 16 months to 6 years* are invited to an Open Studio Day. Try a free class, meet our faculty, and explore our studios. Learn more and sign up today bostonballet.org/dorchester-enroll
- **Open Streets Boston - Jamaica Plain** — Aug. 2, 10:30:00
  The festivals, organized by outside consultant Shana Bryant of Manifested Entertainment, will continue in four sections of Boston starting on Aug. 2 in Jamaica Plain. All events take place from 10:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Streets will be closed
